title: Mobile phone bill - overdue reminder
source: synthetic (written for this project; organisations and people are fictional)
notes: Synthetic test document. It follows the structure of the real document type but is not an actual letter from any organisation.
summary_en: An overdue mobile phone balance of $86.40 must be paid by September 20, 2026 or service may be suspended; payment can be made in the app or by phone.
text:
Brightline Mobile (fictional)
Payment reminder
Account: 555-0101
Your balance of $86.40 is past due. Please pay by September 20, 2026 to avoid a service suspension and a $10 reconnection fee.
Pay in the app, online, or call 1-877-555-0101.
